raw.headline: Household lacks enough backup for a 136-hour outage
raw.decision: Leave for a powered location before the storm; current backup (6.5 h) is far below the 136-hour outage record.

items.requirement: Keep both Inogen batteries fully charged
items.gap: Only 6.5 h planned backup vs 136 h outage
actions: Charge both batteries on mains now
Verify car-DC input works for charging

items.requirement: Have an external power source for the stationary concentrator
items.gap: Zero backup hours; concentrator stops when power fails
actions: Obtain a compatible battery backup unit
Connect concentrator to outdoor generator if available
Keep spare oxygen cylinders as backup

items.requirement: Provide backup power for the CPAP machine
items.gap: No internal battery; CPAP stops without mains
actions: Test the pack with the device before storm
Store the pack fully charged and accessible

missing.why: Provides power for all medical devices when grid fails
missing.action: Buy a generator rated for medical device use and store fuel safely

missing.why: Keeps CPAP running during brief outages until generator starts
missing.action: Select a UPS with sufficient runtime for the CPAP load

missing.why: Ensures oxygen supply if concentrators lose power
missing.action: Obtain at least two full-size cylinders and a regulator

event.name: Hurricane Irma
event.harm: 16 carbon monoxide deaths after Irma; 3 oxygen-dependent patients and 17 heat deaths tied to power loss (CDC MMWR 2018).

items.label: Inogen One G5
items.cover: Up to 13 h at flow setting 1
facts: Double battery: up to 13 h (manual); runtime falls at higher flow settings.
Recharge takes up to 6 h on mains.
Car DC input 13.5-15.0 V, 10 A max.
items.source: Inogen One G5 user manual, rev C
